headline: $500M worker retraining push lifts Egalitarian Utopia
body: A modestly brighter day. RAISE US, a nonprofit led by Gina Raimondo and Eric Holcomb, launched with more than $500 million from Amazon, Anthropic, Microsoft and the OpenAI Foundation to retrain workers, aiming for $1 billion. Spreading AI's benefits raises Shared Prosperity, the main ingredient of Egalitarian Utopia, a world where AI wealth is shared by everyone. In Washington, the House Science Committee advanced 10 bipartisan AI bills on research compute, security, flaw reporting, provenance, workforce and data-center energy, a small plus for Global Coordination that nudges Gatekeeper up and Self-Destruction down. Horizon Balance rose to +0.89.
movers_note: Egalitarian Utopia +0.4, Self-Destruction -0.1 and Gatekeeper +0.1. RAISE US drove Egalitarian Utopia (+0.42 from that event); the House bills did the rest.
